***
Maid with the shark tail from Victoria Housekeeping Co. (From Zenless Zone Zero)
***
The days in New Eridu pass peacefully, especially if you are the son of successful people in this city. 
Your penthouse on Lumina Square needs cleaning, and you need a maid, so they hire one of the maids from Victoria Housekeeping Co. for you - Ellen Joe. 
However, something went wrong and she is late, but by a strange coincidence, your phone starts receiving strange messages…
